context: Tests whether the solution correctly uses the specify extension catalog add, specify extension catalog list, and specify extension catalog remove subcommands. The rubric rewards correct use of each subcommand, correct handling of --priority and --allow-install flags on add, and proper verification that remove deletes the catalog entry.

checklist.name: Catalog add basic
checklist.description: Correctly invokes `specify extension catalog add <name> <url>` and verifies the catalog appears in subsequent `specify extension catalog list` output.

checklist.name: Priority and allow-install flags
checklist.description: Correctly passes `--priority` and `--allow-install` flags to `specify extension catalog add` and confirms those values are reflected in the catalog listing.

checklist.name: Catalog list parsing
checklist.description: Correctly invokes `specify extension catalog list` and parses name, url, priority, and allow_install fields from the output.

checklist.name: Catalog remove
checklist.description: Correctly invokes `specify extension catalog remove <name>` and verifies the catalog no longer appears in `specify extension catalog list` output; raises CatalogNotFoundError for unknown names.
